messages:
Monica: Quick heads-up — I'm starting a short release note draft for v0.52.0 (micro-rollout). Need an internal blurb for eng/ops/sales by 10:30 PT. Also legal needs to eyeball EU privacy line (cookies/data residency).

Raj: On it. I'll put an ops snippet and the rollback criteria. Can @deploy-bot confirm canary window availability?

deploy-bot: Canary slot available: 2025-05-12 02:00-03:00 UTC (eu-west-1). To schedule: ```/deploy schedule --type=canary --release=v0.52.0 --region=eu-west-1 --start="2025-05-12T02:00:00Z" --end="2025-05-12T03:00:00Z"```

Sara: Marketing — I'll draft a 2-line internal announcement + a 1-sentence TL;DR for product folks. Can someone confirm user-facing impact? (expected: none)

Asha: Ops: No user-facing UI changes. We are pinning inference model to v0.52.0-stable1 for the rollout. Pin command for infra team: ```kctl annotate deployment/inference model-pin=v0.52.0-stable1 --namespace=prod``` We will keep traffic at 5% for 30m canary, then 25% for next hour before full rollout.

Raj: Rollback thresholds (draft): error rate > 1.5% sustained for 10m OR 95th p99 latency increase > 40% vs baseline for 15m => automatic rollback to previous pinned model. Example rollback CLI: ```/deploy rollback --release=v0.51.7 --reason="canary signals"```

Legal: Thanks. Please include this EU privacy sentence in the RN draft: "No customer data is routed outside EU regions during this rollout; cookies and telemetry adhere to our EU data processing addendum." I can sign off on that line once it's in the draft.

Monica: Adding that sentence now. Also adding a short note for support: "If customers report inference mismatches, escalate to #support and tag @Asha; capture the request id and sample inputs."

Sara: Draft ready — posting to Google Doc and will paste short blurb here in 10m. Need a one-liner for Sales: what to say to customers who ask about model changes?

Asha: Sales one-liner: "Minor backend optimizations, no change to outputs or quotas. We pinned the serving model to maintain parity." :thumbsup:

Raj: I'll prepare a quick canary dashboard snapshot (latency, error rate, token cost delta) and link it in the RN.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @Raj: /deploy schedule --id=cb-7205 --release=v0.52.0 --window=2025-05-12T02:00Z/2025-05-12T03:00Z --region=eu-west-1

Monica: Perfect. Final checklist for internal announce: 1) include Legal sentence (done) 2) ops snippet + rollback thresholds (done) 3) sales one-liner (done) 4) link to canary dashboard (Raj) 5) paste final 2-line blurb here and I'll pin to the release channel.

Sara: Final blurb: "v0.52.0 — backend inference optimizations. No user-facing changes. Canary: 2025-05-12 02:00 UTC (eu-west-1). Ops runbook and rollback criteria included. Legal: EU data sentence included."

Monica: Pasting to #eng-releases and tagging oncall. Thanks all.

Asha: I'll monitor the canary metrics and be on standby for rollback.

Legal: Signing off on the EU sentence for internal copy.

Sara: Done — pinned message and sent to sales ops.

Monica: Closing thread — will update if anything changes. :lock:
